purpose: Wiki combat stats (Infobox Bonuses) for style===magic wearables. Candidates only — do not merge into equipment.json without a separate agent. Magic style bonus maps to bonuses.damage.

mapping.accuracy: Infobox Bonuses accuracy (or Comparison of high-level magic weapons Accuracy column)
mapping.damage: Infobox Bonuses magic (style bonus) → bonuses.damage; weapon damage field only when non-zero (spell weapons are usually 0 and omitted)
mapping.setId: Preserved from equipment.json or inferred from piece name

sourcesPrimary: Per-item Infobox Bonuses via wiki API action=query&prop=revisions
warnings: item:blast-diffusion-boots: equipment.json lists tier 90; wiki Infobox is tier 80 power (T90 is Enhanced blast diffusion boots)
item:body-helmet: wiki page Body helmet is Elemental Workshop (tier ~10 tank) — not T100 magic power; bonuses left empty pending name fix
item:limitless-staff: equipment aggregate for Staff of limitless * family — no single Infobox; accuracy 2023 from comparison table applies to each elemental staff
item:ahrims-book-of-magic: equipment name is 'book of magic'; wiki title Ahrim's book of magic
item:dragon-defender: tagged magic in equipment.json but is melee defender — stats not magic-class; left empty
item:elysian-spirit-shield / spectral-spirit-shield: tagged magic but hybrid/melee-class shields on wiki — left empty for magic pass
item:elite-seasingers-hood/top/bottom: wiki titles not Elite seasinger's * — superior set uses Superior seasinger's * (not elite); pages missing under Elite seasinger armour names
